title: Corso in post-war Italy, Knight of Malta

tellings.quote: Colonel Philip J. Corso, later famous for his claims regarding reverse engineering alien materials at the Pentagon in his book, The Day After Roswell, served as a high-ranking intelligence officer in Italy during the post-war period.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Philip J. Corso, an Army colonel who later became famous for his book The Day After Roswell, served as a senior intelligence officer in Italy after the Second World War. In that book Corso claimed the Pentagon had copied technology from alien material. The story's title also links Corso to the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic order of knights, and Michels raises the Italian years as background to where Corso's connections may have come from.
